objective: Review the in-place status/readiness hardening for the non-executing native-parser adapter-payload to sidecar plan-resolution fixture and accept only the readiness-classified helper behavior before any sidecar_handoff_contract production, command synthesis, execution, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing claim.

review_decision.reason: The implementation matches the reviewed readiness contract: the outer status is now a direct Verilator option readiness classification derived from sidecar_stage_plan status plus nested verilator_option_readiness, while the original stage_plan_status remains visible in plan_resolution_readiness and in the full stage_plan. Ready template, resident not-ready, persistent-resident not-ready, and unsupported modes are covered by focused contract tests.
review_decision.weakest_point: ready_for_verilator_option_shim can still be over-read as native Verilator execution, sidecar runtime handoff, or correctness evidence. The implementation is accepted only because it keeps command synthesis, sidecar_handoff_contract, operator plan, execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary filelist expansion, and automatic allocation absent, and because plan_resolution_readiness states that readiness is not execution or compare evidence.

accepted_readiness_summary.readiness_only_non_claim: ready_for_verilator_option_shim is readiness only, not native Verilator execution, correctness, timing, upstream support, or sidecar runtime handoff evidence
